# Mobile App Framework

> White-label, AI-native React Native framework in TypeScript (strict). Hexagonal packages (@org/*),
> clean-architecture feature modules, MVVM/MVI, typed DI, Redux Toolkit, REST/GraphQL/WebSocket,
> i18n + RTL, design tokens, observability, vendor-neutral AI with tool calling.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, invariants, where code goes
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): layer graph, boot sequence, HTTP pipeline, patterns
- [Building features](docs/features.md): checklist and rules of thumb
- [Brands](docs/brands.md): white-labelling and brand repos
- [ADRs](docs/adr/README.md): why things are the way they are

- [foundation](packages/foundation/README.md), [di](packages/di/README.md), [observability](packages/observability/README.md), [storage](packages/storage/README.md)
